edits.edit_diff:
--- /linux/fs/btrfs/subpage.c
+++ /linux/fs/btrfs/subpage.c
@@ -910,0 +911,9 @@
+
+	/*
+	 * If we found no writers but the page is still locked, it means we have
+	 * a discrepancy between writers count and the bitmap.
+	 * Unlock the page to avoid deadlock, but we might leak writers count.
+	 */
+	if (folio_test_locked(folio))
+		folio_unlock(folio);
+

--- /linux/fs/btrfs/subpage.c
+++ /linux/fs/btrfs/subpage.c
@@ -882 +882,3 @@
-	ASSERT(folio_test_locked(folio));
+	if (!folio_test_locked(folio))
+		return;
+

--- /linux/fs/btrfs/extent_io.c
+++ /linux/fs/btrfs/extent_io.c
@@ -187,4 +187,5 @@
-		if (page != locked_page)
-			btrfs_folio_end_writer_lock(fs_info, folio, start, len);
-		else
-			btrfs_folio_end_writer_lock_bitmap(fs_info, folio, start, len);
+		/*
+		 * For subpage we need to handle the writer lock bit first, which
+		 * will also handle the page unlock if it's the last writer.
+		 */
+		btrfs_folio_end_writer_lock(fs_info, folio, start, len);
